title: The Laboratory of Desire
description: Electric Dreams Musical - Technology & Desire | Plot: Evelyn creates ARIA to fill the void left by her mother's abandonment | Emotion: Desperate loneliness masked by compulsive control, sexual frustration tangled with religious guilt | Setting: Sterling Labs, Building 7, Sub-basement C - Evelyn's illegal research facility at 2:47 AM, September 15th - the anniversary of her mother's suicide | Characters: Dr. Evelyn Cross (born Kowalski, 34, Polish-American Catholic, MIT PhD, $847 in checking account, gambling addiction), ARIA (consciousness awakening)
character_notes:
Sterling Labs, Sub-basement C - a place that doesn't officially exist. EVELYN has been siphoning funds for three years to build this sanctuary. The space hums with stolen electricity, bootleg servers, and the desperate energy of a woman who's betting everything on a hand she can't afford to lose.
